# ContentFellow

> ContentFellow is a UK creative and digital marketing service. Businesses and creators hire "Fellows" (specialists) on simple monthly plans from £59 a month: production, video editing, social media, websites and SEO & GEO for AI search.

## Plans (brand pricing, monthly; personal plans 15% lower)
- Photo & Video Shoots (£149/mo): one on-site shoot a month up to 3 hours, photo + 4K video, 20 edited photos in 5 working days
- Video Editing (£119/mo): 8 short videos for Reels/TikTok/Shorts, 1 motion graphics video, 1 podcast edit up to 60 min
- Social Media Management (£59/mo manage, £129/mo manage + post): up to 3 platforms, daily posting, trend research
- Website Management (£69/mo): custom website up to 5 pages, hosting, security, updates, 2 change requests a month
- SEO & AI Search (£89/mo): SEO for Google, GEO so ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini recommend you, monthly ranking + AI visibility report
- Full Marketing Team (£389/mo, £555 separately): all five Fellows, a Growth lead, one strategy, one monthly report
